implementation.registry: Frozen full-player signatures include weights, selector, catalog, history and routing. Native environment/scenario/failure contract/split define pools.
implementation.scheduler: Fixed manifest pairs and independent seed blocks; both player seats. Up to two CPU lanes, persistent inference services, fresh histories. No adaptive matchmaking.
implementation.persistence: Fresh private run directory; accepted-command journals, per-game outcomes, block JSONL, immutable input/source hashes, inference counters and progressive report.
implementation.ratings: Anchor-relative 400 log10(score/(1-score)), with two-sided paired-block Hoeffding bounds. Infinite estimates remain explicitly unbounded. No transitive global rating fit; every cross-play edge is retained.
implementation.uncertainty: 95% cell intervals and Bonferroni simultaneous 95% anchor intervals. No endpoint inference from a running preview. No anytime significance claim.
implementation.failures: Policy exceptions forfeit; command caps draw; shared/ambiguous engine failures invalidate the whole seed pair. All attempts and failure counts remain visible. Native rejection is never silently awarded as a win.
implementation.evidenceSafety: Duplicate seed/matchup/pool evidence is rejected; changed player signatures fail. Missing cross-play cells stay unmeasured. Development and consumed-confirmation results cannot become fresh confirmation.

estimates.basis: Retained complete-game wall rates plus the one-lane integration smoke, not extrapolation from the restricted regression engine.

uncertaintyCost.note: Bound geometry only, not a power calculation or authorization for a larger run. Sixty-four games screen large effects; they cannot reliably resolve small gains with this conservative interval.

gpu.assessment: Existing model API accepts up to 64 encoded decisions per request, but frozen native games advance through sequential legality/projection/IPC. No new GPU throughput or utilization claim is supported. Batch ready decisions across independent environments only after measuring inference share; changing device/runtime gets a separate identity and equivalence checks. CPU simulation parallelism and read-only snapshot ingestion provide useful work immediately.

meteredCpuInference.workload: Two completed baseline-versus-AgentPult-scripted games on one CPU lane, plus model preflight/cleanup; shared host load uncontrolled.
meteredCpuInference.note: One run, not CPU/GPU comparison. Client counters time awaited model requests including their IPC; model loading and feature encoding are outside these counters. The Amdahl bound is workload-specific and optimistic; it says nothing about fitting or dual-neural self-play. No GPU throughput measurement was made.
